top_signals.title: JD Sports cuts profit forecast as Régis Shultz growth plan slows
top_signals.summary: JD Sports has slashed its profit target and posted slowing sales, as the growth plan led by chief executive Régis Shultz loses steam.  The sports and fashion retailer saw sales performance improve in the UK, but a slowdown in the US and intense discounting by rivals is dragging on the firm’s profit, it said on [...]
